title: Add the @objectstack/spec patch changeset PR #23780 owed: its position.zod.ts anchor docblock ships in dist/*.d.ts (contract review 6214176883 FAIL on the changeset; merged by the maintainer, follow-up recognised)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a bookkeeping follow-up of a landed PR** (the no-escalation class: changeset tidying with no product-visible behaviour change). Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 2, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's 「同意」 to the recognition row for PR #23780 in this session's chat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happened

PR #23780 (`Fixes #23373`, merged by `os-zhuang` on 2026-10-16 as `6f7ad7900`) changed four texts under ruling C of #23267 and carried `skip-changeset`. Its contract review 6214176883 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) found every ① judgment RIGHT and judged ② **FAIL**: the changed `EVERYONE_POSITION` / `GUEST_POSITION` anchor docblock in `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` ships twice in `@objectstack/spec` — in the tarball by `files[]` (`src/**/*.zod.ts`) and in `dist/*.d.ts` (tsup `dts` on) — so the hover text an author or an AI reads changed, and a patch changeset was owed. The `@objectstack/lint` comment edits owe nothing (`dist` strips them). The maintainer merged the PR by hand with that record standing, recognised the row in the director seat's chat, and took this follow-up.

## What done looks like

- One `.changeset/*.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **patch**, `Clause-②: no`, saying the anchor docblock on `EVERYONE_POSITION` / `GUEST_POSITION` now reads that packages suggest `everyone` bindings only and that no door binds `guest` until ADR-0138 D3 item 5's door is built (the sentence PR #23780 landed).
- No other file. The changeset-family gates (`check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`) pass on the PR.

## Lane and re-check

`domain:spec` (the published package is `@objectstack/spec`). Before writing: `git log --oneline -1 origin/main -- packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` names PR #23780's merge, and `git grep -n "no door binds" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` hits.

## Dedupe

Open `domain:spec` cards whose title names PR #23780, position.zod or a changeset at filing (REST, first 100): #23887. Dedupe words: #23780 changeset owed position.zod.ts docblock dist d.ts spec patch skip-changeset FAIL ②.
